summary.text: James Thibault is a Republican state representative from Merrimack District 25 who has served since December 4, 2024, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, after advancing from the September 8, 2026 primary.

paragraphs.text: Thibault was born in Laconia, New Hampshire, and has been affiliated with the New Hampshire Legislative Youth Advisory Council, according to Ballotpedia.
